title: Israel's Sin and the Servant's Obedience

questions.question: Thus says the LORD: "Where is your mother's certificate of divorce, with which I sent her what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 50:1 (ESV): "with which I sent her away?"

questions.question: Behold, for your iniquities you were sold, and for your transgressions your mother was sent what?
Is my hand shortened, that it cannot redeem? Or have I no power to what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 50:2 (ESV): "Or have I no power to deliver?"

questions.question: The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of those who are what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 50:4 (ESV): "the tongue of those who are taught,"

questions.question: I gave my back to those who strike, and my cheeks to those who pull out the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 50:6 (ESV): "to those who pull out the beard;"

questions.question: I hid not my face from disgrace and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 50:6 (ESV): "I hid not my face from disgrace and spitting."

questions.question: But the Lord GOD helps me; therefore I have not been disgraced; therefore I have set my face like a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 50:7 (ESV): "I have set my face like a flint,"

questions.question: He who vindicates me is near. Who will contend with me? Let us stand up how?
Behold, the Lord GOD helps me; who will declare me what?
Behold, all of them will wear out like a garment; the moth will eat them what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 50:9 (ESV): "the moth will eat them up."

questions.question: Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the voice of his servant? Let him who walks in darkness and has no light trust in the name of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 50:10 (ESV): "trust in the name of the LORD"

questions.question: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who equip yourselves with burning torches! Walk by the light of your fire, and by the torches that you have what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 50:11 (ESV): "by the torches that you have kindled!"

questions.question: This you have from my hand: you shall lie down in what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 50:11 (ESV): "you shall lie down in torment."

questions.question: The Lord GOD has opened my ear, and I was not rebellious; I turned not what?

key_verse_text: But the Lord GOD helps me; therefore I have not been disgraced; therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be put to shame.
